description: Migrate DDB Explorer TUI from tview/tcell to Bubble Tea with full feature parity, centered screen layouts, and keyboard-first workflows.

userStories.title: Add Bubble Tea dependencies
userStories.description: As a developer, I need bubbletea, bubbles, and lipgloss configured so the new TUI can compile and run.
acceptanceCriteria: go.mod includes github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea, github.com/charmbracelet/bubbles, and github.com/charmbracelet/lipgloss
go mod tidy completes successfully
Existing non-TUI packages continue compiling

userStories.title: Create modular tui package structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need app, views, components, styles, keys, and messages split into dedicated files under tui/.
acceptanceCriteria: tui/ package structure is created and builds
main.go only performs startup wiring and launches tea program
No circular imports are introduced

userStories.title: Define shared styles and palette
userStories.description: As a developer, I need centralized lipgloss styles for consistent visual language across screens.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared colors and style primitives are defined in tui/styles
Title, hint, error, success, and highlight styles are exported
Styles are reused by multiple views

userStories.title: Centralize key bindings and message types
userStories.description: As a developer, I need global and view-scoped key maps plus typed tea messages to keep updates predictable.
acceptanceCriteria: Global keys (quit, back, help) are defined once
View-specific keys are grouped by feature
Load/query/scan success and error messages are modeled as typed messages

userStories.title: Implement loading view
userStories.description: As a user, I need a centered loading view with spinner so app startup feels responsive and clear.
acceptanceCriteria: Loading view renders spinner and context text
Loading content is horizontally and vertically centered
Resize updates keep the loading screen centered

userStories.title: Implement table list view
userStories.description: As a user, I need to browse and filter DynamoDB tables with keyboard navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Table list shows name, items, size, and status
Filter input updates visible rows live
Selection opens query/scan flow
Primary table list screen is centered within available content area

userStories.title: Implement query and scan forms
userStories.description: As a user, I need centered forms for query and scan operations with predictable focus handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Query form supports partition key, optional sort key, and optional index
Scan mode provides explicit trigger action
Form focus order is keyboard-friendly
Form layouts stay centered during resize

userStories.title: Implement results table and pagination
userStories.description: As a user, I need paginated query/scan results with adaptive columns and keyboard navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Results table columns adapt to discovered item fields
Pagination status is visible and updates correctly
Keyboard navigation supports row and page movement
Results layout remains centered and does not overlap chrome

userStories.title: Implement item detail and centered JSON modal
userStories.description: As a user, I need detailed item inspection and raw JSON modal display for deeper analysis.
acceptanceCriteria: Item detail view renders key-value rows clearly
JSON modal opens from detail context and supports scrolling
JSON modal is centered in terminal viewport
Large values remain readable without breaking layout

userStories.title: Integrate app state machine and shared chrome
userStories.description: As a developer, I need one app model that owns view transitions, layout calculations, and global chrome.
acceptanceCriteria: All transitions are represented by explicit view-state values
Window resize updates dimensions for current view and components
Help bar and status bar render consistently across views
All primary screens are centered using a shared layout strategy

userStories.title: Wire async commands and failure handling
userStories.description: As a user, I need safe async load/query/scan operations with clear error visibility and recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Table load, query, and scan run through tea.Cmd patterns
Recoverable errors are surfaced in UI without app crash
Update paths avoid invalid intermediate state transitions
No error is silently ignored

userStories.title: Add migration verification tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests for state transitions, resize behavior, and centered layout helpers.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover core view-state transition paths
Tests validate resize-driven layout recalculation
Tests cover centering behavior for main views and modal
go test ./... passes

functionalRequirements: FR-1: Replace tview/tcell rendering and input handling with Bubble Tea architecture.
FR-2: Keep existing aws package behavior unchanged.
FR-3: Use an explicit view-state machine for all navigation.
FR-4: Render help and status chrome consistently for every primary view.
FR-5: Center all primary screens in the available content region.
FR-6: Center modal overlays relative to terminal dimensions.
FR-7: Recompute layout deterministically on tea.WindowSizeMsg.
FR-8: Preserve keyboard-only completion of core workflows.
FR-9: Surface recoverable command errors to users clearly.
FR-10: Provide loading states for table listing and data retrieval operations.
nonGoals: Adding new product capabilities beyond current app scope
successMetrics: All baseline flows are available in Bubble Tea implementation
All primary views remain centered during terminal resize
Keyboard-only user can complete end-to-end query workflow
Regression tests pass in CI and locally
